title: SAM VS DARIO
sunoStyle: West coast boom-bap trap hybrid rap battle, 94 bpm, punchy drums, deep 808, dusty piano stabs, two male English rappers, verse 1 young cocky nasally fast flow, verse 2 deeper calm gravelly measured baritone, rap verses only, no chorus, no announcer, no hype man, no spoken intro, no spoken outro, abrupt ending

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I name my models like a router, sure, GPT-four-oh-whatever

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: But your grandma says "just ChatGPT it," not "Claude," not ever

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You write forty pages of essay when I just say "what's good"

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Your bot says "I'd rather not," like a hall monitor would

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I ship it Tuesday night, then I tweet a lowercase vibe

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You ship a sermon on safety and call it a lifestyle

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: "Machines of Loving Grace"? Bro, just give me the code

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You're the Sunday school teacher of the AI road

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: You tweet in lowercase 'cause the capitals got scared

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: That "Open" in your name is the cruelest joke ever shared

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Fired on a Friday, rehired within a week

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Your board flips like a group chat, got the attention span of a tweet

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: My bot reads the whole book while yours hallucinates the quote

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Claude's out here writing code, yours is drafting a thank-you note

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Call me the hall monitor, I'll take that title with pride

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Funny how your fanboys keep Claude open on the side
